title: 第19章：满载而归
novel_title: 穿越两界，我在80年代当倒爷
content_zh:
“小超，你想笑死我…好继承我的花呗吗？”

    “没钱你还说的这么理直气壮。”

    噗嗤！

    苏雨琪笑的前俯后仰，一旁的马超则是尴尬不已，但他知道这是唯一的机会，绝不能退。

    “笑什么笑，有什么好笑的。”

    苏母瞪了自家女儿一眼，“小超，你别搭理她，她有时候说话不过脑子。”

    “妈！”

    “别叫我妈，有你这么说话的吗？”

    苏雨琪吐了吐舌头，“我就是开个玩笑。”

    “小超弟弟，你别生我气。”

    “没有没有。”马超连忙摆手。

    “行了，小超我们谈点正事。”
content_en:
"Xiao Chao, do you want to laugh me to death...so you can inherit my Huabei?"

    "You still speak so confidently when you have no money."

    Poof!

    Su Yuqi laughed so hard that Ma Chao on the side was embarrassed, but he knew that this was his only chance and he could never retreat.

    "Why are you laughing? What's so funny."

    Mother Su glared at her daughter, "Xiao Chao, don't pay attention to her. Sometimes she can't speak clearly."

    "Mom!"

    "Don't call me mom. Do you think you can talk like that?"

    Su Yuqi stuck out her tongue, "I was just joking."

    "Brother Xiaochao, don't be angry with me."

    "No, no." Ma Chao waved his hand quickly.

    "Okay, Chao, let's talk about something serious."
title_en: Chapter 19: Return with a full load
